sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small tree, 3–10 m tall, endemic to southern Madagascar between Toliara and Fort-Dauphin. Its opposite, narrow, often slightly sickle-shaped leaves have three basal veins. Small white flowers have four parts and four stamens and develop into an elongated capsule.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: No food use is documented in the sources consulted.
